title: Convergence or divergence in open source
summary: We are investigating whether AI agents lead open-source projects toward similar library choices or encourage a more diverse ecosystem, using repository mining and static analysis.

title: Tracing calls to understand what developers test
summary: Exploring how LLM-assisted call tracing can help us understand what developers test: connecting test code with the software behavior it exercises.

title: Professional software workers with coding agents
summary: We are studying how, why, and when professionals outside traditional developer roles use coding agents at work, and how they collaborate with developers on their teams.

title: Managing AI agents: a workspace shadowing study
summary: A workspace shadowing study of the interleaving nature of working with AI agents: how software creators switch between tasks and agents, and the challenges and opportunities of managing a swarm of AI agents.
